level_name: Act I - The Elderwood & The Fallen Watch

props.lore_text: Commander Kaelen felled this rift-drake during the opening charge, buying the vanguard time to reach the treeline.
props.corruption_low: Its scales still bear the clean silver scorch of Kaelen's blade.
props.corruption_high: Black flies hum over the drake's ribs, drawn to the mark on your hand.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Standing Torch.png
props.lore_text: A Watch-torch still burning with oil and pine-resin. Corporal Vane stood triple-watch here the night the supply line was severed.
props.corruption_low: The warm flame steadies your breathing against the forest chill.
props.corruption_high: The flame bends away from your shadow as you pass.

props.lore_text: Four bedrolls and a half-melted Watch kettle surround the embers. Here your squad shared their last meal before marching into the rift.
props.corruption_low: You can almost hear Garrick's deep laugh and Solen's quiet hymn over the crackling wood.
props.corruption_high: The hearth fire sputters low, chilled by the demonic aura clinging to your cloak.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Wooden Shed.png
assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Stacked Rocks.png
assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Stacked Rocks.png

props.lore_text: Beyond this hollowed trunk lie the graves of previous runners who accepted Andras's bargain and never returned.
props.corruption_low: You grip your hilt tighter, vowing to bring your comrades' names back to the light.
props.corruption_high: The carved face in the bark seems to nod in grim recognition of the mark on your palm.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Stacked Rocks.png
props.lore_text: Stacked river stones topped with a dented Star-Fire helmet. Garrick built this cairn alone while holding the rear.
props.corruption_low: You place a small stone atop the pile in silent salute.
props.corruption_high: The silver star on the helmet tarnishes as your shadow crosses it.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Standing Torch.png

props.lore_text: Charred pages of the vanguard muster roll flutter around a low fire. Orin tried to keep the names dry as the dark closed in.
props.corruption_low: A few unburned pages still preserve the oaths of your company.
props.corruption_high: The embers flare violet as your corrupted shadow falls across the ledger.

props.lore_text: Silver moonlight pools at the feet of Candora's weathered effigy. Medic Lyra and Pyromancer Solen consecrated this ground against the rift.
props.corruption_low: A cool, Merciful breeze washes over your brow - Candora still walks with you.
props.corruption_high: The statue's silver eyes weep pale light, pleading for you to cast off Andras's hold.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Standing Torch.png
assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Standing Torch.png
assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Wooden Shed.png

props.lore_text: Solen kept this sacred brazier burning for seven nights to guide lost Watchmen through the fog - until the rift turned his flames against him.
props.corruption_low: Golden sparks rise gently from the hearth, recognizing an uncorrupted brother.
props.corruption_high: The brazier crackles with urgent warning: Solen awaits ahead, consumed by the ash.

props.lore_text: Scorched prayer beads lie scattered across the steps. Ahead stands Pyromancer Solen, guarding the last Tear of Candora.
props.corruption_low: May your blade grant Solen the peaceful rest he earned.
props.corruption_high: Claim Candora's Tear from Solen - it may be your last chance to cleanse the demon's brand!

props.lore_text: Kaelen's scabbard is driven into the earth beside the dying fire. Scratched into the leather: 'If I fall to the Marquis, send my student to finish the watch.'
props.corruption_low: Your hand steadies on your hilt. You will not let your mentor remain a puppet.
props.corruption_high: The brand on your palm throbs violently - Andras is eager to see student and master collide.

props.texture_path: assets/Pixel Art Tiles and Backgrounds - Mountains/Decoration/Standing Torch.png

props.lore_title: Sanctum of the Bleeding Great Tree
props.lore_text: Crimson sap weeps from the ancient canopy above the stone arch. Commander Kaelen stands waiting in the silence ahead.
props.corruption_low: Remember every lesson he taught you. Free your Commander.
props.corruption_high: The rift roars in your ears - the final vessel trial is at hand.

params.title: Chronicle of the Fourth Vanguard
params.text: The field ledger of your fallen company pulses with a faint ember. Every page smells of pine-smoke and iron.
combat_taunts: Read the names of the Fourth Vanguard before the ash claims them!
Four officers marched ahead of you into the Elderwood - none have returned.
params.death_line: Carry our names to the end of the woods...

dialogue.default: The field ledger of your fallen company pulses with a faint ember. Every page smells of pine-smoke and iron.

corruption_variants.low: The silver Watch ink shimmers warmly - your comrades' memories still anchor your humanity.
corruption_variants.mid: Ash smudges the margins where Andras's sigil touched the parchment.
corruption_variants.high: At the bottom of the casualty roll, your own name is already being written in shadow.

params.text: Vane's Distress Cipher|Seven hash-marks are gouged into the bleeding bark ahead - Corporal Vane's signal that the vanguard was cut off.
The Shattered Rearguard|Broken Star-Fire shields line the ditch. Garrick held this narrow pass alone while the wounded fell back.

params.title: The Moonstone Keeper
params.text: Garrick stood at the Obsidian Gate just ahead until his mortal heart gave out - and Andras locked him inside his own armor.
combat_taunts: Steel yourself, Guardian. Freeing a brother-in-arms requires a steady heart.
Candora's moonlight judges all who step across these graves.
params.death_line: May silver grace guide your blade...

dialogue.default: Garrick stood at the Obsidian Gate just ahead until his mortal heart gave out - and Andras locked him inside his own armor.

corruption_variants.low: Your heart still beats in human cadence. Grant Garrick the honorable release of a Watchman.
corruption_variants.mid: Shadow clouds your sword-arm, yet your eyes still grieve for your squad. Hold onto that grief.
corruption_variants.high: Only cold void remains in your chest. If you strike Garrick down in hatred, you only feed the Marquis.

params.title: Scribe Orin of the Watch
params.text: I recorded every soul Andras hollowed from our company. Take this torn muster page - do not let the Citadel forget what we sacrificed.

dialogue.default: I am Scribe Orin of the Fourth Vanguard. Even in the dark, I keep the roll of our fallen brothers so their names are not swallowed by the rift.

corruption_variants.low: Your name is still unstained on my parchment, Guardian. Keep your blade clean.
corruption_variants.mid: Soot is gathering around your entry in the ledger. Seek Candora's Moon-Shrines ahead to cleanse it.
corruption_variants.high: The Marquis is already dictating your final title across the bottom of the page.

params.text: Sanctuary of the Silver Moon|White lilies bloom through the ash around Candora's ruined shrines. Ahead, Pyromancer Solen's sacred hearth has turned to wildfire.

params.title: Candora's Envoy
params.text: Pyromancer Solen wept as the rift corrupted his sacred flame. When you free him, claim Candora's Silver Tear from his robes - it will purge Andras's venom from your soul.

dialogue.default: Candora sent me to find the last Guardian of the Fourth Vanguard. Pyromancer Solen awaits at the ruined altar ahead, fighting to keep one last Silver Tear pure for you.

corruption_variants.low: She still sees her starlight in you, Guardian. Solen's gift will make your spirit unbreakable.
corruption_variants.mid: She grieves for the shadow creeping up your arm, but Solen's Silver Tear will wash the brand away.
corruption_variants.high: You are nearly lost to the Marquis - only Solen's Tear can pull you back from the abyss now!

params.text: Trail of the First Vessel|Clean, lightning-fast sword cuts scar the ironwood trees ahead. Only Commander Kaelen's blade leaves a mark like that.

params.title: Echo of Lieutenant Marek
params.text: Commander Kaelen ordered us to stay behind while he marched to the Bleeding Tree alone. He took Andras's full curse to buy your life - go free him!

dialogue.default: I was Kaelen's second-in-command. He knew Andras needed a master swordsman as his vessel, so he offered himself at the Bleeding Tree to spare you.

corruption_variants.low: You fought through the entire forest without losing your heart - just as Kaelen believed you would.
corruption_variants.mid: This is the mile where the curse is heaviest. Remember Kaelen's teachings, not the demon's fury.
corruption_variants.high: If you strike our Commander down while drunk on Andras's power, you will become the new Dark Ronin in his stead!

params.text: The Bleeding Great Tree|The wind dies completely. Beneath the crimson canopy ahead, Commander Kaelen slowly draws his blade.
